plugins.name: laya
plugins.description: Hand structured decisions (classify, triage, tag, score, yes/no checks) to the shared Laya classifier over MCP, and set up the connection.

plugins.name: laya-support
plugins.description: Support team toolkit: slash commands (/triage, /chase, /labels) that read the support Slack channel, classify issues with Laya, and draft the digest, nudges and dataset updates for approval. Do not install together with the laya plugin.
